description: Search Moroccan public-sector recruitment exams (concours) with the website's own filters. Open exams only unless include_closed is true. Returns grade, employer, posts, deadline, salary, the Wadifa Info page url and the official notice url. Use list_filters for exact diploma and region values.

diploma.description: Diploma filter value from list_filters (Arabic label).

include_closed.description: Also return exams whose deadline has passed.

lang.description: Language of the labels: fr (default) or ar.

q.description: Keywords: grade, employer or city, in French or Arabic (e.g. 'technicien', 'ministère de la santé', 'متصرف').

name: search_concours
title: Search public-sector recruitment exams
